fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: The .SettingContent-ms file type was introduced in Windows 10 and allows a user to create "shortcuts" to various Windows 10 setting pages. These files are simply XML and contain paths to various Windows 10 settings binaries.
fields.name: Arbitrary Shell Command Execution Via Settingcontent-Ms
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (tgt.process.cmdline contains ".SettingContent-ms" and (not tgt.process.cmdline contains "immersivecontrolpanel")))
